scope: Curated subset of local evidence, not the full PSI repository
ranking: Direct topic matches, supporting topics, then other topics; within each tier modeled, reference, metadata; then alphabetical. Curator-defined discovery order, not scientific safety or AI confidence.

entries.name: BASS-II / PMMA rods
entries.objective: Study opposed flame spread over cylindrical PMMA under different oxygen, flow and gravity conditions.
entries.configuration: Opposed flow; Earth ground tests and ISS microgravity
entries.conditions: Oxygen, diameter and imposed flow. Per-run pressure is unresolved.
entries.hardware: BASS-II flow duct / Microgravity Science Glovebox; separate ground apparatus
entries.available: 69 modeled records: 35 Earth means + 34 ISS segments
entries.limits: 11 ISS rates retain an inferred-unit flag. Shared specimen grouping is provisional. No validated lunar predictor.
entries.utility: Compare within-environment rate estimates and identify where physics or Earth-to-ISS transfer fails.

sources.locator: Appendix A, PDF p114 / printed p106

entries.name: FLEX
entries.objective: Investigate droplet combustion and inert-gas suppressant mixtures in microgravity.
entries.configuration: ISS microgravity; recorded O2 / N2 / CO2 / He mixtures
entries.measurement: Average slope magnitude of droplet diameter squared versus time
entries.conditions: Initial diameter, pressure in mmHg and gas mole fractions.
entries.hardware: Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus / Combustion Integrated Rack
entries.available: 198 eligible / 274 source CSV records; 79 condition groups
entries.limits: Rate model only; no extinction probability, causal suppressant ranking or dose recommendation. Disrupted trials excluded.
entries.utility: Compare measured burning constants with held-out estimates and inspect the largest errors across recorded mixtures.

sources.locator: K definition PDF p25; Table IX pp26–34

entries.name: SAME / SAME-R
entries.objective: Study smoke aerosols relevant to spacecraft detection.
entries.material: Smoke-producing samples; material and aging conditions in the local tables
entries.configuration: Microgravity smoke experiments; aging and inlet conditions vary
entries.measurement: Local files describe experiment settings, not paired detector-response labels
entries.conditions: SAME: material, airflow, weight-loss setting, aging. SAME-R: material, inlet velocity, duration and aging.
entries.hardware: Smoke aerosol measurement instrumentation; full sensor-response files needed
entries.available: 8 SAME design-summary rows; 109 SAME-R metadata records
entries.limits: Aged measurements can share a test. The SAME-R date field omits the year. No accepted smoke/dust classifier dataset.
entries.utility: Find relevant smoke studies and identify the response measurements required before detector modeling.

entries.name: Saffire I–III

entries.material: SIBAL fabric and other solid specimens, depending on campaign
entries.configuration: Microgravity; concurrent/opposed entries must remain distinct

entries.name: LUCI
entries.objective: Examine material burning at lunar-like gravity produced by vehicle rotation.
entries.material: 4 mm PMMA rod and cotton/fiberglass fabric sheet
entries.configuration: Rotating suborbital vehicle; lunar-like acceleration, not the lunar surface
entries.measurement: Flame growth/spread reference fits from camera observations
entries.units: mm/s for curated reference fits; different target definitions
entries.conditions: Changing chamber oxygen; orientation and Coriolis effects matter.
entries.hardware: Rotating New Shepard payload; two orthogonal cameras
entries.available: 6 separately curated reference values; not 6 independent tests
entries.limits: Upward tip/base growth is not opposed leading-edge spread. Not a compatible answer key for our PMMA model.
entries.utility: Identify real partial-gravity evidence and explain the target-matching gap before lunar validation.
